name: RaportLabs
title: Native procedure orders, reports and results
description: Requires api:fhir and system/Patient.$raport-labs. No input parameters. Returns all active procedure orders for the patient, including pending orders, legacy/default order types and non-laboratory types (type is preserved), their ordered tests and answers, all reports and all results. Records and references use native UUIDs; tests use order UUID plus native sequence. Families are ordered order/test/answer/report/result, then UUID or composite source key. Native strings, lifecycle statuses, zero values, range text, comments and stored date offsets are retained without guessing clinical meaning or terminology. Linked encounters must have unambiguous same-patient ownership and pass sensitivity/category ACLs. Linked result documents require documents ACL and same-patient ownership. Source inconsistencies fail with 409; permissions fail with 403, never a partial complete response. Missing UUIDs are filled with the host helper before a repeatable-read snapshot. Complete covers the fields declared here, not detailed specimens, billing/account data, attachment bytes or linked patient messages.

parameter.name: complete
parameter.documentation: True only when every in-scope row and link was read successfully.
